dedupe_keys.name: lesotho bureau of statistics 2016 population and housing census analytical report volume iiib with housing tenure wall roof and floor materials lighting heating and cooking fuel by district settlement type and ecological zone plus the census village list with households and population by enumeration area

description: The Lesotho Bureau of Statistics publishes the 2016 Population and Housing Census analytical report on socio-economic characteristics as a zipped PDF of 101 pages. Chapter 2 covers housing, with tables on land tenure, type of housing unit, ownership, rooms and wall, roof and floor materials by main type of house, and reports that 42.7 percent of households lived in housing with sand or concrete block walls and 29.9 percent in stone and mud. Chapter 3 covers amenities, with lighting fuel by settlement type, electricity use by census year, heating fuel by ecological zone and cooking energy by district. Heating gets its own section because some localities lie at 1,800 metres or more, with winter nights below freezing. The census village list in Excel gives households and population for each village with its enumeration area code, constituency, council, ecological zone and settlement type. Coverage is national. Format and access: free zipped PDF and XLSX, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the report tables are in PDF; the village list has counts only, not amenities; the 2026 census was in progress. Simulation uses: heating and lighting fuel by zone for energy access and cold-climate demand studies, and village households for service planning. Related records: IPUMS International and the WorldPop population grid.

Chapter 3: lighting fuel by settlement and house type, electricity for lighting by census year, heating fuel counts and by ecological zone, cooking energy by district, possessions by district (tables 3.1 to 3.10). Village list: district, constituency, council, enumeration area code, ecological zone, settlement, village name, households, population by sex.
